explanation: God's loving and gracious care for people, especially in their distress and suffering.
The principle of acting rightly and in accordance with moral and ethical norms; in the book of Psalms it is often linked to God's character and actions.
A feeling of security and belief that someone will fulfill their promises and obligations; in the book of Psalms this often refers to trust in God.
Unmerited goodness and mercy shown by God to people, even though they do not deserve it because of their sins and failures.
Another name for God, emphasizing his authority and sovereignty over all creation.
A reverent respect and submission toward God, acknowledging his almighty power and authority.
God's ability and willingness to guard and preserve his people from danger and evil.
A place of safety and rest; in the book of Psalms it often refers to God's protective presence.
A metaphor for God's life-giving and renewing power, which brings comfort and hope to believers.
Time without end; in the book of Psalms this often refers to God's eternal existence and his promises of eternal life for believers.
